edr-bot: ALERT — macOS EDR detected suspicious dynamic library injection (high) on host `sam-mbp` (user: Samira Khan)
edr-bot: Process: /Applications/Visual Studio Code.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron (pid 12901)
edr-bot: Injected module: /Users/samira/Library/Application Support/Code/Plugins/helperhook.dylib (sha256:abcd1234f6e7... )
edr-bot: Action: network quarantine + process snapshot collected

Maria Chen: Samira, are you at that laptop right now?

Samira Khan: yes, i'm here. vscode froze then popped that alert.

Maria Chen: please disconnect from wifi and don't reboot. we'll need live artifacts.

Samira Khan: unplugging wifi now. not rebooting.

security-oncall: created INC-2024-5125 for this. tagging eng-security + infra-cicd. Samira, any recent 3rd-party installs or extensions?

Rajiv Singh: first containment: isolate host in EDR console (if not already), export process snapshot and EDR logs, collect osquery.

Samira Khan: i installed an extension earlier called `terminal-sudo-helper@1.2.0` from marketplace. i'll remove it and upload the folder.

Leo Park: Samira — run these and paste outputs: 
```bash
# EDR collect
edrctl collect --host sam-mbp --out /tmp/samira-edr.tgz
# suspect file info
ls -la "~/Library/Application Support/Code/Plugins/helperhook.dylib"
shasum -a256 "~/Library/Application Support/Code/Plugins/helperhook.dylib"
# process tree
ps -o pid,ppid,comm -p 12901 && pstree -p 12901 || true
```

Samira Khan: edrctl upload started — will post link when complete. removed the extension.

edr-bot: EDR collection complete: https://edr.internal/collects/1719998888-samira

Samira Khan: file hash matches alert: abcd1234f6e7...

Jake Morales: checking cloud audit logs for any KMS/API calls tied to developers' sessions. give me a minute.

Jake Morales: quick check — AWS CloudTrail and GCP audit logs show no Decrypt/GenerateDataKey or suspicious token exchange from Samira's dev session in the last 24h.

Maria Chen: good but assume potential exposure until we rotate. Samira please rotate any keys you used today and sign out of SSO sessions.

Samira Khan: rotating keys now, signing out of sessions. also running a full Malwarebytes scan.

edr-bot: Quarantine action: moved /Users/samira/Library/Application Support/Code/Plugins/helperhook.dylib -> /var/edr/quarantine/1719998888-helperhook.dylib

Lisa Nguyen: next triage: (1) collect osquery recent process execs, (2) check LaunchAgents and loginitems, (3) inspect the extension manifest for remote downloads or native code loads.

Samira Khan: uploading extension folder to secure share now.

Maria Chen: SIEM search for hash/filename across endpoints and CI.

Maria Chen: SIEM hit: same sha256 on a CI runner (runner-03) two days ago. pinging @infra-cicd for runner investigation.

security-oncall: escalating to infra-cicd and SRE. marking as potential small campaign. please treat runner-03 as suspect and isolate.

Rajiv Singh: open forensic snapshot ticket and request disk image from Samira. if image can't be done promptly, grab EDR snapshot + full osquery export.

Samira Khan: handing laptop to security for imaging. thanks for the quick triage :thumbsup:

Maria Chen: great work team. we'll continue writeups in INC-2024-5125. closing Slack updates to reduce noise — continue updates in the incident ticket.
